title: Sebastian and the Static
author: Quentin Dunmore
blurb: Mirabel Halloran, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
